status: confirmed 2026-10-03: the four options and their citations, by both sides

options.outline: no fault confirmed after a BIT re-run: return to service and monitor
reseat the module connector and re-run BIT
replace the array module from a spare on hand
replace the array module with a spare from the nearest site with stock
options.picture_condition: picture.spare.on_hand_here == 0 and picture.nearest_spare is not null

dry_run_note: nearest is the spares source's configured nearest-first order, not the least lead time (edge-02 has 1 at 1 day but is second in edge-01's order).
open_questions: remove_install: the consumer's option shape has one dmc; this manual has separate remove (520) and install (720) modules, given here as a list. Either the shape takes a list or the manual merges them.
planning_interval: the consumer's walk cites 320 for its interval. The options cite it for none of the four; whether option 4 should cite it (scheduling the replacement) is open.

on_hand_here: the consumer's contract retires picture.spare.on_hand_here and its reader binds dotted paths only, so option 3 has no other field to read; either the consumer keeps reading it, or nearest_spare includes the owning site when it has stock.
